title: route B's own uniform raster, graded with the tethers its span distribution implies, over the lattice phase as a design variable
verificationType: logical (exact integer residue arithmetic on this repository's own honeycomb crossover lattice, reproduced against T-304's committed uniformRasters at every (width, phase) row) + in-silico (the same honeycomb grillage and the same T-299 tether element, at a PER-TURN span) + literature (C-0193's and C-0200's reading of the built allowance, T-71's measured phosphate radius and T-230's ssDNA Kuhn and contour brackets)
maturity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. NOT empirically demonstrated. The three widths are what three scaffolds afford at the built 28 nt allowance; no such raster has been drawn, let alone folded, and this repository cannot fold one.

units.level: integer base pairs on one global z
units.dishing: dimensionless, as a fraction of the free stroke

conventions.the row length: the PAIRED row, scaffoldNucleotides / 60 - 28, which is what the built allowance fixes; edgeX is that many base pairs at 0.34 nm/bp and edgeY is unchanged at 10 row pitches, exactly C-0201 section 7's construction
conventions.the lattice phase: b0, the class-zero staple residue. On a raster that does not close it is a free DESIGN VARIABLE and is never derived here
conventions.the anchor reading: anchorOffsetBasePairs = 0 -- route B's unpaired loop sits OUTBOARD of the duplex, C-0200's reading of the built block
conventions.the two rim chains: C-0200 splits the 28 unpaired bases 12 / 16 per helix, so a turn joins two duplex ends 24 or 32 nucleotides apart; which rim takes which half is a free convention of that reading and BOTH assignments are swept, beside C-0193's uniform 28 / 28
conventions.the preload: the chain's tension enters as +f times unitZ on the link gradient, so the nine IN-PLANE turns contribute exactly zero and the fifty through-thickness ones carry it. That zero is a property of the MODEL -- it has no in-plane transverse coordinate -- and not of the chain
conventions.dishing: peakDishing(81) over the mean deflection under the uniform interior pressure on the SAME lattice; C-0167's convention, tolerance T-5b = 0.10

parameters.raster: uniform, route B -- the paired row is scaffoldNucleotides / 60 - 28
parameters.chainReadings: 28 nt at both rims (C-0193); C-0200's ordered split: 24 nt low, 32 high; C-0200's ordered split exchanged: 32 nt low, 24 high
parameters.subdivisions: 1 at every headline cell; 2 on the convergence axis
parameters.whyTheRegimeBlockIsNull: environment.Regime holds the gap and the bias as INTERVALS and refuses a degenerate one; this study solves no electrostatics, it reads ONE profile record of T-3b and uses it as a fixed load shape, so the state is a POINT (C-0181, CH-0224)

sources: gpd/results/T-3b-tile-edge-load-profile.json (C-0022's solved collar at 2 mM / 10 nm / 0.192 V)

citedInputs.C-0200 the built unpaired split: 12 / 16 per helix, so 24 or 32 per turn

cheapBound.question: how much larger is the uniform raster's chain tension than the determined raster's?
cheapBound.answer: the determined span is 0.787091706 nm and carries 0.175872271 to 0.256181866 pN; a uniform route-B raster's 59 turns carry a MEAN of 3.14109619 to 4.49761906x that, and a worst of 6.64777142x
cheapBound.consequence: C-0204 measures the preload's own worth on the free tile at the determined span as 0.00708426936 to 0.0195297045 of the stroke; a mean tension a few times larger, on top of C-0201's untied 0.0422200543 to 0.0451172785, predicts a reading that STRADDLES T-5b -- which is why the question needed a solve and not only an estimate

cheapBound.stage: 2 -- the unit-tension bank, 59 solves per width
cheapBound.question: can the whole phase and corner axis be bounded without re-solving?
cheapBound.answer: yes. A tether's tension is C-0104's internal initial stress: it changes no entry of the stiffness matrix and the field is exactly linear in it. One unit-tension solve per turn gives a RIGOROUS triangle-inequality ceiling at every phase and every corner with no further solve
cheapBound.consequence: the ceiling is honoured at 756 of 756 cells (F7), and the bank's linear superposition reproduces the exact solve to 0.0068 of the stroke -- which MEASURES what the tether's own stiffness is worth rather than assuming it

cheapBound.stage: 3 -- what the cheap bound could not decide
cheapBound.question: does the estimate settle the verdict?
cheapBound.answer: no. The tension ratio is a level and the dishing is a SIGNED superposition over 59 sites with two through-thickness azimuths of opposite unitY, so a larger tension everywhere does not imply a larger peak. The ceiling is rigorous and loose
cheapBound.consequence: the exact solve is what decides, and the bank is retained as the control on it
